description: Hyper-V monitoring for prometheus-community/windows_exporter v0.31.8 (hyperv collector)。结构：①最上「总览」= 全部 Hyper-V 主机的固定汇总，不随筛选变化；②「宿主机总览」= 同款式，跟随筛选；③其余明细面板跟随筛选。作用域优先级：VM > 主机 —— 只要虚拟机变量里有值，所有面板（含宿主机维度）都以该 VM 所在主机为准，VM 维度面板只显示这台 VM；清空虚拟机后按主机变量过滤（显示该主机的全部 VM）；两者都空则只显示顶部汇总总览。

panels.title: 总览 · Overview（全部 Hyper-V 主机汇总 · 不随筛选变化）

panels.description: 【全部 Hyper-V 主机汇总】整个环境的一个汇总值，不是每台主机一条。= 非空闲逻辑核 / 逻辑核总数。分母用 hyperv 自身每核一条的 % Total Run Time 序列计数得到，不依赖其他 collector。
panels.title: 宿主机 CPU 使用率

panels.description: 【全部 Hyper-V 主机汇总】整个环境的一个汇总值，不是每台主机一条。windows_hyperv_hypervisor_logical_processor_total_run_time_total（每核 % Total Run Time）求和 = 忙核数。注意：v0.31.8 的 exporter 已把 100ns 计数器换算为秒，rate() 直接就是核数，不要再除以 1e7。
panels.title: 宿主机 CPU 占用（核）

panels.description: 【全部 Hyper-V 主机汇总】整个环境的一个汇总值，不是每台主机一条。所有虚拟处理器 % Total Run Time 之和，即所有 VM 合计消耗的物理核数。
panels.title: 全部 VM CPU 占用（核）

panels.description: 【全部 Hyper-V 主机汇总】整个环境的一个汇总值，不是每台主机一条。dynamic_memory_vm_physical_bytes 求和（仅开机的 VM 有实例）。注意官方文档写成 dynamic_memory_vm_physical，源码里实际是 dynamic_memory_vm_physical_bytes。
panels.title: VM 内存分配合计

panels.description: 【全部 Hyper-V 主机汇总】整个环境的一个汇总值，不是每台主机一条。以 VID Partition 有性能计数器实例的 VM 计数；关机的 VM 不会有实例。
panels.title: 运行中的 VM 数

panels.description: 【全部 Hyper-V 主机汇总】整个环境的一个汇总值，不是每台主机一条。windows_hyperv_virtual_machine_health_total_count 带 state 标签（ok / critical），必须按 state 过滤，否则一个面板会出现两条线。
panels.title: VM 健康
宿主机总览 · Filtered（仅筛选中的 Hyper-V 主机）

panels.description: 【筛选主机】未选主机但选了 VM 时，自动切换到该 VM 所在主机。= 非空闲逻辑核 / 逻辑核总数。分母用 hyperv 自身每核一条的 % Total Run Time 序列计数得到，不依赖其他 collector。

targets.expr: sum by (instance) (((rate(windows_hyperv_hypervisor_logical_processor_total_run_time_total[5m]) and on(instance) windows_hyperv_vid_physical_pages_allocated{vm=~"$vm"}) or (rate(windows_hyperv_hypervisor_logical_processor_total_run_time_total{instance=~"$instance"}[5m]) unless on() windows_hyperv_vid_physical_pages_allocated{vm=~"$vm"}))) / count by (instance) (((windows_hyperv_hypervisor_logical_processor_total_run_time_total and on(instance) windows_hyperv_vid_physical_pages_allocated{vm=~"$vm"}) or (windows_hyperv_hypervisor_logical_processor_total_run_time_total{instance=~"$instance"} unless on() windows_hyperv_vid_physical_pages_allocated{vm=~"$vm"}))) * 100

panels.title: 宿主机 CPU 使用率

panels.description: 【筛选主机】未选主机但选了 VM 时，自动切换到该 VM 所在主机。windows_hyperv_hypervisor_logical_processor_total_run_time_total（每核 % Total Run Time）求和 = 忙核数。注意：v0.31.8 的 exporter 已把 100ns 计数器换算为秒，rate() 直接就是核数，不要再除以 1e7。

targets.expr: sum by (instance) (((rate(windows_hyperv_hypervisor_logical_processor_total_run_time_total[5m]) and on(instance) windows_hyperv_vid_physical_pages_allocated{vm=~"$vm"}) or (rate(windows_hyperv_hypervisor_logical_processor_total_run_time_total{instance=~"$instance"}[5m]) unless on() windows_hyperv_vid_physical_pages_allocated{vm=~"$vm"})))

panels.title: 宿主机 CPU 占用（核）

panels.description: 【筛选主机】未选主机但选了 VM 时，自动切换到该 VM 所在主机。所有虚拟处理器 % Total Run Time 之和，即所有 VM 合计消耗的物理核数。

targets.expr: sum by (instance) (((rate(windows_hyperv_hypervisor_virtual_processor_total_run_time_total[5m]) and on(instance) windows_hyperv_vid_physical_pages_allocated{vm=~"$vm"}) or (rate(windows_hyperv_hypervisor_virtual_processor_total_run_time_total{instance=~"$instance"}[5m]) unless on() windows_hyperv_vid_physical_pages_allocated{vm=~"$vm"})))

panels.title: 全部 VM CPU 占用（核）

panels.description: 【筛选主机】未选主机但选了 VM 时，自动切换到该 VM 所在主机。dynamic_memory_vm_physical_bytes 求和（仅开机的 VM 有实例）。注意官方文档写成 dynamic_memory_vm_physical，源码里实际是 dynamic_memory_vm_physical_bytes。

targets.expr: sum by (instance) (((windows_hyperv_dynamic_memory_vm_physical_bytes and on(instance) windows_hyperv_vid_physical_pages_allocated{vm=~"$vm"}) or (windows_hyperv_dynamic_memory_vm_physical_bytes{instance=~"$instance"} unless on() windows_hyperv_vid_physical_pages_allocated{vm=~"$vm"})))

panels.title: VM 内存分配合计

panels.description: 【筛选主机】未选主机但选了 VM 时，自动切换到该 VM 所在主机。以 VID Partition 有性能计数器实例的 VM 计数；关机的 VM 不会有实例。

targets.expr: count by (instance) (((windows_hyperv_vid_physical_pages_allocated and on(instance) windows_hyperv_vid_physical_pages_allocated{vm=~"$vm"}) or (windows_hyperv_vid_physical_pages_allocated{instance=~"$instance"} unless on() windows_hyperv_vid_physical_pages_allocated{vm=~"$vm"})))

panels.title: 运行中的 VM 数

panels.description: 【筛选主机】未选主机但选了 VM 时，自动切换到该 VM 所在主机。windows_hyperv_virtual_machine_health_total_count 带 state 标签（ok / critical），必须按 state 过滤，否则一个面板会出现两条线。
panels.title: VM 健康
宿主机 CPU · Hypervisor Logical Processor

panels.description: windows_hyperv_hypervisor_logical_processor_time_total{core,state}，state ∈ guest / hypervisor / idle，每核三态之和 ≈ 1。rate() 的值域是 0-1（占该核的比例），所以不要除以 1e7。
panels.title: 每个逻辑核的占用（核）

panels.description: guest = 虚拟机消耗，hypervisor = 虚拟化开销，idle = 空闲。三条之和 ≈ 该主机的逻辑核总数，属正常。

targets.expr: sum by (instance, state) (((rate(windows_hyperv_hypervisor_logical_processor_time_total[5m]) and on(instance) windows_hyperv_vid_physical_pages_allocated{vm=~"$vm"}) or (rate(windows_hyperv_hypervisor_logical_processor_time_total{instance=~"$instance"}[5m]) unless on() windows_hyperv_vid_physical_pages_allocated{vm=~"$vm"})))

panels.title: 宿主机 CPU 按 state 拆分（核）

panels.description: Hypervisor 自身 = state="hypervisor" 的逻辑核；根分区 = 宿主 OS 自身的 vCPU 占用（hypervisor_root_virtual_processor_total_run_time_total 只有 core 标签，官方文档里的 state="total" 在 v0.31.8 不存在）。

targets.expr: sum by (instance) (((rate(windows_hyperv_hypervisor_logical_processor_time_total{state="hypervisor"}[5m]) and on(instance) windows_hyperv_vid_physical_pages_allocated{vm=~"$vm"}) or (rate(windows_hyperv_hypervisor_logical_processor_time_total{instance=~"$instance",state="hypervisor"}[5m]) unless on() windows_hyperv_vid_physical_pages_allocated{vm=~"$vm"})))

sum by (instance) (((rate(windows_hyperv_hypervisor_root_virtual_processor_total_run_time_total[5m]) and on(instance) windows_hyperv_vid_physical_pages_allocated{vm=~"$vm"}) or (rate(windows_hyperv_hypervisor_root_virtual_processor_total_run_time_total{instance=~"$instance"}[5m]) unless on() windows_hyperv_vid_physical_pages_allocated{vm=~"$vm"})))

panels.title: Hypervisor 与根分区 CPU（核）

panels.description: rate(windows_hyperv_hypervisor_logical_processor_context_switches_total{core})。
panels.title: 逻辑处理器上下文切换速率
虚拟机 CPU · Hypervisor Virtual Processor

panels.description: sum by (instance, vm)：把该 VM 的所有 vCPU 加起来，得到消耗的物理核数。rate() 已是核数，无需 /1e7。

targets.expr: sum by (instance, vm) ((rate(windows_hyperv_hypervisor_virtual_processor_total_run_time_total{vm=~"$vm"}[5m]) or ((rate(windows_hyperv_hypervisor_virtual_processor_total_run_time_total[5m]) and on(instance) sum by (instance) (windows_hyperv_hypervisor_logical_processor_time_total{instance=~"$instance"})) unless on() windows_hyperv_hypervisor_virtual_processor_total_run_time_total{vm=~"$vm"})))

panels.title: 每台 VM 的 CPU 占用（核）

panels.description: 当前瞬时快照，按占用降序。

targets.expr: sum by (instance, vm) ((rate(windows_hyperv_hypervisor_virtual_processor_total_run_time_total{vm=~"$vm"}[5m]) or ((rate(windows_hyperv_hypervisor_virtual_processor_total_run_time_total[5m]) and on(instance) sum by (instance) (windows_hyperv_hypervisor_logical_processor_time_total{instance=~"$instance"})) unless on() windows_hyperv_hypervisor_virtual_processor_total_run_time_total{vm=~"$vm"})))

panels.title: VM CPU 占用排行（核）

panels.description: windows_hyperv_hypervisor_virtual_processor_time_total{vm,core,state}，state 实际取值只有 hypervisor / guest / remote。

targets.expr: sum by (instance, vm, state) ((rate(windows_hyperv_hypervisor_virtual_processor_time_total{vm=~"$vm"}[5m]) or ((rate(windows_hyperv_hypervisor_virtual_processor_time_total[5m]) and on(instance) sum by (instance) (windows_hyperv_hypervisor_logical_processor_time_total{instance=~"$instance"})) unless on() windows_hyperv_hypervisor_virtual_processor_time_total{vm=~"$vm"})))

panels.title: 每台 VM 的 CPU 按 state 拆分（核）
虚拟机内存 · Dynamic Memory 与 VID

panels.description: windows_hyperv_dynamic_memory_vm_physical_bytes{vm}（源码里由 MB × 1024 × 1024 换算成字节）。关机 VM 不会出现。

targets.expr: (windows_hyperv_dynamic_memory_vm_physical_bytes{vm=~"$vm"} or ((windows_hyperv_dynamic_memory_vm_physical_bytes and on(instance) sum by (instance) (windows_hyperv_hypervisor_logical_processor_time_total{instance=~"$instance"})) unless on() windows_hyperv_dynamic_memory_vm_physical_bytes{vm=~"$vm"}))

panels.title: 每台 VM 已分配物理内存

panels.description: windows_hyperv_dynamic_memory_vm_pressure_current_ratio{vm}。exporter 做了 PercentageToRatio（÷100），所以 1.0 = 100%。单位应选 percentunit 而不是 percent。

targets.expr: (windows_hyperv_dynamic_memory_vm_pressure_current_ratio{vm=~"$vm"} or ((windows_hyperv_dynamic_memory_vm_pressure_current_ratio and on(instance) sum by (instance) (windows_hyperv_hypervisor_logical_processor_time_total{instance=~"$instance"})) unless on() windows_hyperv_dynamic_memory_vm_pressure_current_ratio{vm=~"$vm"}))

panels.title: 每台 VM 内存压力（0-1）

panels.description: windows_hyperv_dynamic_memory_vm_guest_available_bytes{vm}：需要 Windows Server 2019（build 17763）及以上才有数据。

targets.expr: (windows_hyperv_dynamic_memory_vm_guest_available_bytes{vm=~"$vm"} or ((windows_hyperv_dynamic_memory_vm_guest_available_bytes and on(instance) sum by (instance) (windows_hyperv_hypervisor_logical_processor_time_total{instance=~"$instance"})) unless on() windows_hyperv_dynamic_memory_vm_guest_available_bytes{vm=~"$vm"}))

panels.title: 每台 VM 客户机可用内存

panels.description: current / minimum / maximum 压力带（均为 0-1 比值）。持续贴近 maximum 说明内存吃紧。

targets.expr: (windows_hyperv_dynamic_memory_vm_pressure_current_ratio{vm=~"$vm"} or ((windows_hyperv_dynamic_memory_vm_pressure_current_ratio and on(instance) sum by (instance) (windows_hyperv_hypervisor_logical_processor_time_total{instance=~"$instance"})) unless on() windows_hyperv_dynamic_memory_vm_pressure_current_ratio{vm=~"$vm"}))

(windows_hyperv_dynamic_memory_vm_pressure_minimum_ratio{vm=~"$vm"} or ((windows_hyperv_dynamic_memory_vm_pressure_minimum_ratio and on(instance) sum by (instance) (windows_hyperv_hypervisor_logical_processor_time_total{instance=~"$instance"})) unless on() windows_hyperv_dynamic_memory_vm_pressure_minimum_ratio{vm=~"$vm"}))

(windows_hyperv_dynamic_memory_vm_pressure_maximum_ratio{vm=~"$vm"} or ((windows_hyperv_dynamic_memory_vm_pressure_maximum_ratio and on(instance) sum by (instance) (windows_hyperv_hypervisor_logical_processor_time_total{instance=~"$instance"})) unless on() windows_hyperv_dynamic_memory_vm_pressure_maximum_ratio{vm=~"$vm"}))

panels.title: 每台 VM 内存压力区间

panels.description: windows_hyperv_vid_physical_pages_allocated{vm}，判断 VM 是否存在最稳的指标，也用来驱动 $vm 变量。

targets.expr: (windows_hyperv_vid_physical_pages_allocated{vm=~"$vm"} or ((windows_hyperv_vid_physical_pages_allocated and on(instance) sum by (instance) (windows_hyperv_hypervisor_logical_processor_time_total{instance=~"$instance"})) unless on() windows_hyperv_vid_physical_pages_allocated{vm=~"$vm"}))

panels.title: 每台 VM 分配的物理页数

panels.description: windows_hyperv_dynamic_memory_balancer_available_memory_bytes / _available_memory_for_balancing_bytes，label 为 balancer。
panels.title: 动态内存均衡器可用内存
网络 · Virtual Network Adapter / vSwitch

panels.description: label 是 adapter（网卡名），不是 vm。指标是 CounterTypeRaw 的累计字节数，所以必须用 rate()。
panels.title: 虚拟网卡吞吐

panels.description: windows_hyperv_vswitch_bytes_received_total / _bytes_sent_total（前缀仍是 vswitch_，不是 virtual_switch_），label 为 vswitch。
panels.title: 虚拟交换机吞吐

panels.description: windows_hyperv_virtual_network_adapter_incoming_dropped_packets_total / _outgoing_dropped_packets_total。
panels.title: 虚拟网卡丢包

panels.description: windows_hyperv_vswitch_dropped_packets_incoming_total / _dropped_packets_outcoming_total（注意上游拼写是 outcoming）以及扩展丢包。
panels.title: 虚拟交换机丢包

panels.description: windows_hyperv_virtual_network_adapter_drop_reasons{adapter,direction,reason}，指标名没有 _total 后缀。

targets.expr: sum by (instance, adapter, direction, reason) (((rate(windows_hyperv_virtual_network_adapter_drop_reasons[5m]) and on(instance) windows_hyperv_vid_physical_pages_allocated{vm=~"$vm"}) or (rate(windows_hyperv_virtual_network_adapter_drop_reasons{instance=~"$instance"}[5m]) unless on() windows_hyperv_vid_physical_pages_allocated{vm=~"$vm"})))

panels.title: 虚拟网卡丢包原因排行
存储 · Virtual Storage Device

panels.description: windows_hyperv_virtual_storage_device_bytes_read / _bytes_written，label 是 device（形如 VM 名 + 控制器信息），不是 vm。
panels.title: 虚拟磁盘吞吐

panels.description: windows_hyperv_virtual_storage_device_operations_read_total / _operations_written_total 的速率。
panels.title: 虚拟磁盘 IOPS

panels.description: v0.31.8 中 latency_seconds / lower_latency_seconds 是 PERF_AVERAGE_TIMER 原始值（100ns tick 的累计和，单调递增），不能直接画。平均 IO 延迟 = rate(延迟 tick) / 1e7 / rate(throughput)，其中 throughput 是该平均值的基数（完成的 IO 次数）。v0.32+ 已改名为 windows_hyperv_virtual_storage_device_io_latency_seconds_total（已换算成秒）与 ..._throughput_total，对应写法为 rate(io_latency_seconds_total)/rate(throughput_total)。

targets.expr: ((rate(windows_hyperv_virtual_storage_device_latency_seconds[5m]) and on(instance) windows_hyperv_vid_physical_pages_allocated{vm=~"$vm"}) or (rate(windows_hyperv_virtual_storage_device_latency_seconds{instance=~"$instance"}[5m]) unless on() windows_hyperv_vid_physical_pages_allocated{vm=~"$vm"})) / 1e7 / ((rate(windows_hyperv_virtual_storage_device_throughput[5m]) and on(instance) windows_hyperv_vid_physical_pages_allocated{vm=~"$vm"}) or (rate(windows_hyperv_virtual_storage_device_throughput{instance=~"$instance"}[5m]) unless on() windows_hyperv_vid_physical_pages_allocated{vm=~"$vm"}))

((rate(windows_hyperv_virtual_storage_device_lower_latency_seconds[5m]) and on(instance) windows_hyperv_vid_physical_pages_allocated{vm=~"$vm"}) or (rate(windows_hyperv_virtual_storage_device_lower_latency_seconds{instance=~"$instance"}[5m]) unless on() windows_hyperv_vid_physical_pages_allocated{vm=~"$vm"})) / 1e7 / ((rate(windows_hyperv_virtual_storage_device_throughput[5m]) and on(instance) windows_hyperv_vid_physical_pages_allocated{vm=~"$vm"}) or (rate(windows_hyperv_virtual_storage_device_throughput{instance=~"$instance"}[5m]) unless on() windows_hyperv_vid_physical_pages_allocated{vm=~"$vm"}))

panels.title: 虚拟磁盘平均 IO 延迟

panels.description: queue_length / lower_queue_length 与 latency 一样是原始累计值（100ns），需先 rate() 再除 1e7 才是平均队列长度。上游文档给的等价写法：v0.32+ 用 rate(windows_hyperv_virtual_storage_device_io_latency_seconds_total)。持续升高说明底层存储成为瓶颈。
panels.title: 虚拟磁盘平均队列长度
虚拟机清单 · VM Inventory

panels.description: 只包含「有性能计数器实例」的 VM，即开机状态。可用 $vm 变量筛选。

targets.expr: (windows_hyperv_dynamic_memory_vm_physical_bytes{vm=~"$vm"} or ((windows_hyperv_dynamic_memory_vm_physical_bytes and on(instance) sum by (instance) (windows_hyperv_hypervisor_logical_processor_time_total{instance=~"$instance"})) unless on() windows_hyperv_dynamic_memory_vm_physical_bytes{vm=~"$vm"}))

(windows_hyperv_vid_physical_pages_allocated{vm=~"$vm"} or ((windows_hyperv_vid_physical_pages_allocated and on(instance) sum by (instance) (windows_hyperv_hypervisor_logical_processor_time_total{instance=~"$instance"})) unless on() windows_hyperv_vid_physical_pages_allocated{vm=~"$vm"}))

(windows_hyperv_vid_remote_physical_pages{vm=~"$vm"} or ((windows_hyperv_vid_remote_physical_pages and on(instance) sum by (instance) (windows_hyperv_hypervisor_logical_processor_time_total{instance=~"$instance"})) unless on() windows_hyperv_vid_remote_physical_pages{vm=~"$vm"}))

(windows_hyperv_vid_preferred_numa_node_index{vm=~"$vm"} or ((windows_hyperv_vid_preferred_numa_node_index and on(instance) sum by (instance) (windows_hyperv_hypervisor_logical_processor_time_total{instance=~"$instance"})) unless on() windows_hyperv_vid_preferred_numa_node_index{vm=~"$vm"}))

panels.title: VM 清单（内存 / 物理页 / NUMA）

list.name: vm
list.label: 虚拟机 / VM（可留空；输入 .* = 全部 VM）

title: Hyper-V · windows_exporter v0.31.8
